intro: Convert L to gallons US quickly for fuel tanks, aquariums, homebrewing, and liquid storage. One US liquid gallon equals exactly 3.785411784 liters, so dividing liters by 3.78541 converts from a single liter to the gallon scale (1 L ≈ 0.264172 gal). Looking up liters in gallons UK instead? Remember that a UK Imperial gallon holds 4.54609 litres—about 20% more than a US gallon. Use the calculator above or browse our liters to gallons chart below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial & Canadian Gallons
items: 1 US Liquid Gallon equals 3.785411784 litres (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK / Canadian Imperial Gallon equals 4.54609 litres (160 Imp fl oz)—20.1% larger.
Never confuse US gallons with UK Imperial gallons when reading international fuel consumption specs, chemical mixes, or industrial tank labels.

faqs.question: How many litres are in a gallon?
faqs.answer: There are 3.78541 litres in 1 US liquid gallon, and 4.54609 litres in 1 UK Imperial gallon.

faqs.question: How much is a liter in gallons?
faqs.answer: One liter equals 0.26417205 US liquid gallons (about 0.264 gal), or 0.219969 UK Imperial gallons.

faqs.question: How many Canadian litres are in a US gallon?
faqs.answer: A litre is the same standard metric unit in Canada and worldwide, so there are 3.785411784 Canadian litres in 1 US liquid gallon (about 3.79 L).

faqs.question: How many liters are in a Canadian gallon?
faqs.answer: Canada traditionally uses the Imperial gallon in historical references, which holds exactly 4.54609 liters—compared to 3.78541 liters in a US gallon.
